# ROAMSIX

ROAMSIX is an ongoing membership for people who want to make sense of health, experience useful ideas, and stay connected to the experts, resources, and relationships that help the learning continue.

## How People Begin

Public conversations and experiences offer a first way into ROAMSIX. They help people encounter the approach, meet the community, and decide whether an ongoing membership feels right.

Membership provides continuity beyond any single event. Members receive access to the evolving calendar, relevant invitations, practical resources, and a community exploring health, wellness, and human performance throughout the year.

## Membership

Annual options are Core at a founding rate of $850, Field at $2,200, and Journey at $4,500. The standard Core rate becomes $1,100 in 2027. Private membership is invitation-based. Each level is designed for a different degree of participation, booking priority, smaller-group access, and guest participation.

The calendar develops throughout the year around gut health, recovery, focus, and longevity. Members do not need to attend everything or follow the program in sequence. Travel, larger gatherings, multi-day journeys, and selected premium experiences may be priced separately when stated.

## Organizations

ROAMSIX also designs focused experiences and multi-session programs for teams seeking healthier, more sustainable ways to work and perform.

## Location

North County San Diego and South Orange County.
